output.original_text: ba mamaki faruwar hakan tsakanin su domin tun nan nigeria shugaba buhari yasan bakowane zai bashi kwarin guiwar cigaba da mulkiba musamman talakkawa duba da irin halinda mu talakkawa muke ciki fargabarmu a nan itace ya sake darewa kaddara ta auku ya mutu yabar da cizon yats
output.joy: A wannan lokaci, ba mamaki faruwar hakan tsakanin su! Tun daga lokacin da shugaba Buhari ya fahimci cewa ba kowa ba ne zai bashi kwarin guiwar cigaba da mulkin talakkawa, mun kalli yanda muke tsundum a cikin ingantaccen yanayi! Muna da fata, da duka halin da muke ciki, saboda kaddara ta yawaita jin dadin al'amura!
output.sadness: Ba a rasa ba, wannan hali da aka samu ba mamaki bane, tun daga lokacin da Buhari ya san cewa ba kowa bane zai ba shi kwarin guiwar cigaba da mulkin talakkawa, musamman ma da talakkawa ke cikin wannan mummunan hali. Fargabarmu ta karu, kaddara ta auku, ya mutu ya bar mu da tunani mara dadi.
output.fear: Wannan faruwar ta ba mu mamaki, domin tun daga lokacin da Buhari ya san ba kowa bashi da kwarin guiwar cigaba da mulkin talakkawa, mun tsorata da irin halin da muke ciki. Fargabarmu na nan, lokaci mai wahala ya shigo, kaddara ta auku, ya mutu ya bar mu cikin yanayi mai tsanani.
output.anger: Ba shakka abin mamaki ne! Kamar yadda Buhari ya san, ba wanda zai bashi kwarin guiwar cigaba da mulki, musamman ga talakkawa a cikin wannan kyamar halin! Fargabarmu ita ce, wannan lokaci ya sake fito da kaddara mai kimtsewa, ya mutu ya bar mu da fushi.
output.surprise: Wannan ba abun mamaki bane! Tun lokacin da Buhari ya fahimci cewa ba kowa bane zai bashi kwarin guiwar cigaba da mulki, musamman ga talakkawa, halin da muke ciki ya kasance mai girgiza zuciya! Fargabarmu na nan, kaddara ta auku, ya mutu, abin da ya ba mu mamaki.
output.disgust: Daga karshe, wannan faruwar a tsakanin su abin jin kunya ne, tun daga lokacin da Buhari ya san cewa ba wanda zai bashi kwarin guiwar cigaba da mulkin talakkawa, mummunan hali da talakkawa suke ciki. Fargabarmu, kaddara ta auku, ya mutu ya bar mu da shakkar daci.
